name: Amoxicillin
usage: Respiratory tract infections, UTI, Ear infections
resistance_detail: > 70% resistance in E. coli strains in India.
warning: Commonly misused for viral cold/flu. Ineffective against viral infections.

name: Ciprofloxacin
resistance_detail: High resistance observed in Salmonella typhi and E. coli across varied Indian demographics.
warning: Can cause tendon rupture. Not recommended for children.
